name: lab5
services:
  api1:
    environment:
      MONGO_DB: lab5
      MONGO_URI: mongodb://mongo1:27017,mongo2:27017,mongo3:27017/?replicaSet=rs0
      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"
    hostname: api1
    image: lab5-api:local
    networks:
      database: null
      frontend: null
    stop_grace_period: 8s
    build:
      context: /Users/sofiyaserbina/Lab3_Docker_Kubernetes_Lab4/lab5/app
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    depends_on:
      mongo-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - python
        - -c
        - import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:5000/time',timeout=2)
      timeout: 3s
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
  api2:
    environment:
      MONGO_DB: lab5
      MONGO_URI: mongodb://mongo1:27017,mongo2:27017,mongo3:27017/?replicaSet=rs0
      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"
    hostname: api2
    image: lab5-api:local
    networks:
      database: null
      frontend: null
    stop_grace_period: 8s
    build:
      context: /Users/sofiyaserbina/Lab3_Docker_Kubernetes_Lab4/lab5/app
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    depends_on:
      mongo-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - python
        - -c
        - import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:5000/time',timeout=2)
      timeout: 3s
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
  api3:
    environment:
      MONGO_DB: lab5
      MONGO_URI: mongodb://mongo1:27017,mongo2:27017,mongo3:27017/?replicaSet=rs0
      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"
    hostname: api3
    image: lab5-api:local
    networks:
      database: null
      frontend: null
    stop_grace_period: 8s
    build:
      context: /Users/sofiyaserbina/Lab3_Docker_Kubernetes_Lab4/lab5/app
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    depends_on:
      mongo-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - python
        - -c
        - import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:5000/time',timeout=2)
      timeout: 3s
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
  mongo-init:
    restart: 'no'
    entrypoint:
      - mongosh
      - --host
      - mongo1:27017
      - --quiet
      - /scripts/init-replica.js
    image: mongo:7
    networks:
      database: null
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /Users/sofiyaserbina/Lab3_Docker_Kubernetes_Lab4/lab5/init-replica.js
        target: /scripts/init-replica.js
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
    depends_on:
      mongo1:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      mongo2:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      mongo3:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
  mongo1:
    command:
      - mongod
      - --replSet
      - rs0
      - --bind_ip_all
      - --wiredTigerCacheSizeGB
      - "0.25"
    hostname: mongo1
    image: mongo:7
    networks:
      database: null
    stop_grace_period: 5s
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: mongo1-data
        target: /data/db
        volume: {}
      - type: bind
        source: /Users/sofiyaserbina/Lab3_Docker_Kubernetes_Lab4/lab5/init-replica.js
        target: /scripts/init-replica.js
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - mongosh
        - --quiet
        - --eval
        - 'quit(db.adminCommand({ping:1}).ok ? 0 : 1)'
      timeout: 4s
      interval: 5s
      retries: 40
  mongo2:
    command:
      - mongod
      - --replSet
      - rs0
      - --bind_ip_all
      - --wiredTigerCacheSizeGB
      - "0.25"
    hostname: mongo2
    image: mongo:7
    networks:
      database: null
    stop_grace_period: 5s
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: mongo2-data
        target: /data/db
        volume: {}
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - mongosh
        - --quiet
        - --eval
        - 'quit(db.adminCommand({ping:1}).ok ? 0 : 1)'
      timeout: 4s
      interval: 5s
      retries: 40
  mongo3:
    command:
      - mongod
      - --replSet
      - rs0
      - --bind_ip_all
      - --wiredTigerCacheSizeGB
      - "0.25"
    hostname: mongo3
    image: mongo:7
    networks:
      database: null
    stop_grace_period: 5s
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: mongo3-data
        target: /data/db
        volume: {}
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - mongosh
        - --quiet
        - --eval
        - 'quit(db.adminCommand({ping:1}).ok ? 0 : 1)'
      timeout: 4s
      interval: 5s
      retries: 40
  nginx:
    image: nginx:1.27
    networks:
      frontend: null
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /Users/sofiyaserbina/Lab3_Docker_Kubernetes_Lab4/lab5/nginx.conf
        target: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
    depends_on:
      api1:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      api2:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      api3:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 80
        published: "8080"
        protocol: tcp
networks:
  database:
    name: lab5_database
    internal: true
  frontend:
    name: lab5_frontend
volumes:
  mongo1-data:
    name: lab5_mongo1-data
  mongo2-data:
    name: lab5_mongo2-data
  mongo3-data:
    name: lab5_mongo3-data
x-api:

  depends_on:

      condition: service_completed_successfully
  environment:
    MONGO_DB: lab5
    MONGO_URI: mongodb://mongo1:27017,mongo2:27017,mongo3:27017/?replicaSet=rs0
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"
  healthcheck:
    interval: 5s
    retries: 20
    test:
      - CMD
      - python
      - -c
      - import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:5000/time',timeout=2)
    timeout: 3s
  image: lab5-api:local
  networks:
    - frontend
    - database
  stop_grace_period: 8s
x-mongo:
  command:
    - mongod

    - --bind_ip_all
    - --wiredTigerCacheSizeGB
    - "0.25"
  healthcheck:
    interval: 5s
    retries: 40
    test:
      - CMD
      - mongosh
      - --quiet
      - --eval
      - 'quit(db.adminCommand({ping:1}).ok ? 0 : 1)'
    timeout: 4s
  image: mongo:7
  networks:
    - database
  stop_grace_period: 5s
